name: LUMINETH REALM-LORDS: VANARI LORD REGENT
description: Vanari Lord Regents are a powerful and inspiring presence amidst the ranks of the Lumineth infantry. Under their leadership, Auralan Wardens adopt near-unbreakable shield walls to impede the enemy, blunting their assault in readiness for a swift counter-attack.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds a Vanari Lord Regent, an expert warrior and strategist for your Lumineth Realm-lords armies in Warhammer Age of Sigmar. This inspiring leader marches alongside the Vanari forces clad in aetherquartz-empowered armour, cutting foes down with their blades, and rallying the troops to their side. The miniature can be built in one of two different ways – with helmet in hand and back banners fluttering in the breeze, or equipped with a tall shield and wearing a majestic crested helmet.</br></br>This kit comprises 19 plastic components and 1x Citadel 32mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
